#Aletheia #Canada #USPol

Amidst a collapsing trade relationship where the US has slapped 50% tariffs on Canadian goods, Prime Minister Mark Carney defended his diplomatic strategy, claiming ongoing direct communication with Donald Trump.

The Poison:
By pretending that informal phone calls can bypass structural economic hostility, Carney's administration risks delaying necessary domestic economic adaptations in favor of a diplomatic mirage.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This is a Lyrical Error (WHY). The narrative of 'compartmentalization' and 'regular contact' is used to obfuscate the harsh physical reality of a devastating, active trade war.

Carney is running a Smart Selfish Maneuver to protect political capital. He uses the pretext of elite access to distract from Canada's lack of structural leverage, projecting a calm partnership while the US runs an extractive power play.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated diplomatic access and actual economic warfare, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. PR spin is deployed to manage public perception of a structural defeat.

The Unavoidable Truth: Canada-US trade relations have severely deteriorated into an aggressive tariff war despite backchannel chats.

The Unavoidable Lie: Regular phone calls between leaders mean a mutually beneficial trade deal is still actively within reach.
